title: Add test button that logs "Never tell me the odds"
body: ## Summary Adds a **Test** button on the main to-do page that `console.log`s `"Never tell me the odds"` when clicked. ## Changes - `src/App.js` — Test button with click handler - `src/App.css` — button styles matching the existing panel - `src/App.test.js` — unit test asserting the console message ## Test plan - [x] Unit tests pass (`npm test` — 3/3) - [x] App opened at http://localhost:3000 in the virtual desktop - [x] Clicked Test button without opening DevTools (console behavior covered by unit test) ## Demo ![Main page with Test button hovered](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-e464aa07-67b0-4826-868a-256938c5cd82) ![Main page Test button visible](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-2dc99bf0-1455-4e53-a563-6059a151b50d)
